post.text:
Reform UK delivered a real-terms cut to council tax here in Leicestershire.

First time in 12 years the maximum increase hasn’t been passed.

Less tax. More delivery.

That’s Reform UK. 🇬🇧

🔗 https://t.co/aytVQkSKM9 https://t.co/eS6Bcsvvwj

tweetMedia.transcription: Did you know Reform UK councils now have the lowest taxation in the country? And here in Leicestershire we went even further. We delivered a real terms cut to council tax. For the first time in 12 years the maximum increase wasn't proposed. And we've done it while still investing in services despite funding being cut. Less tax, more delivery. That's the difference between Reform UK and the old parties.
